title: Tor & Dark Web Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional letter template to request information about Tor browser usage monitoring, dark web access logs, and anonymous browsing data collection.
description: Use this formal letter template to request information from organizations about their monitoring of Tor browser usage, dark web access tracking, and collection of anonymous browsing data to protect your privacy rights.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:

sections.heading: Subject Line
sections.content: Subject: Privacy Information Request Regarding Tor Browser and Anonymous Browsing Monitoring

sections.heading: Opening Statement
sections.content:
Dear [Recipient Name/Privacy Officer],

I am writing to formally request information about your organization's policies and practices regarding the monitoring, logging, or tracking of Tor browser usage, dark web access, and anonymous browsing activities by users of your network or services.

sections.heading: Specific Information Requests
sections.content:
Please provide detailed information about the following:

1. Network Traffic Analysis: Do you monitor or analyze network traffic to identify Tor browser usage or connections to the Tor network?

2. Dark Web Access Logging: Do you maintain logs of attempts to access .onion sites or other dark web resources?

3. Anonymous Browsing Detection: What methods, if any, do you use to detect or track anonymous browsing activities?

4. Data Collection: What specific data points do you collect related to Tor usage, including IP addresses, timestamps, bandwidth usage, or destination information?

5. Data Retention: How long do you retain any logs or records related to Tor browser usage or anonymous browsing activities?

6. Third-Party Sharing: Do you share Tor usage data with law enforcement, government agencies, or other third parties?

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Rights
sections.content:
This request is made under applicable privacy laws and regulations, including but not limited to [relevant privacy laws in your jurisdiction]. I believe I have the right to understand how my privacy and anonymous browsing activities may be monitored or tracked while using your network or services.

I am particularly concerned about maintaining my privacy rights while using tools like Tor browser and Incognito Browser for legitimate privacy protection purposes.

sections.heading: Response Timeline
sections.content: I respectfully request a written response within [timeframe, typically 30 days] of receipt of this letter. If you cannot provide a complete response within this timeframe, please acknowledge receipt of this request and provide an estimated timeline for your full response.

sections.heading: Contact Information
sections.content:
Please send your response to:
[Your preferred contact method - email or mailing address]

If you have any questions about this request or need clarification on any points, please contact me at [phone number] or [email address].

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to your prompt response and to better understanding your privacy practices regarding anonymous browsing tools.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]

useCases: Requesting information from ISPs about Tor traffic monitoring
Inquiring about workplace network monitoring of anonymous browsing

Contacting VPN providers about Tor usage logging
Requesting transparency from public WiFi providers
Following up on suspicious network blocking of Tor connections
